name: Mesh Loading and Normalization
definition: Loads a 3D model from a file using Assimp, extracts vertices and indices, normalizes the mesh to a unit sphere centered at the origin, and builds an Embree acceleration structure.
summary: Mesh Loading and Normalization imports 3D models, scales them to canonical space, and builds acceleration structures, distinguishing itself by handling file I/O and spatial indexing for ray tracing.
